transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

I'm just really struggling with how my face looks, especially my skin. The acne and scars all over my cheeks are just terrible and so noticeable to everyone. I really need help to finally fix this because I can't live like this anymore.
How much time each day do you spend thinking about your skin or checking it, and do these concerns make it hard to work, study, or socialize?

I easily spend three or four hours every day obsessing over my skin and constantly checking it in the mirror. It has made it almost impossible to focus on my studies, and I often avoid going outside or socializing with my friends because I'm so ashamed of how I look.
